7 انسح It was, or became, spread, spread out or forth, or expanded; as also ↓ تسطّح . (TA.) ―
-b2- Said of a man, He became extended [lying] on the back of his neck, (S, Msb,) affected by a disease of long continuance, or crippled, (Msb,) and moved not: (S, Msb:) or he became thrown down [so that he lay] extended on the back of his neck. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
